primer: Marine Electricals (NSE: MARINE) supplies naval warship power systems and hyperscale data-center Power Train Units. Its backlog hit ₹3,514 Cr on Sep 30, 2026, plus ₹233.21 Cr in Nov 16 orders from STT Global Data Centres and Ganges Shipyard. However, our audit flagged fixed-price margin risk, ₹31.36 Cr in GE arbitration exposure, a ₹14.88 Cr GST demand, 44.5% 10-year CFO/PAT, and 178 Debtor Days. Governance flags also include a ₹70,000 promoter buyout of 70% of MEL Shipyard and a ₹25 Cr guarantee on loss-making Evigo Charge. At ₹400.60 live TV close (2026-11-25; ₹406.95 NSE close 2026-11-23; 70.44x P/E; Stage 3), New Capital is REJECTED (TIER_0), while the 125-share (1.19%) Zerodha holding stays HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at ₹327.13.
